description: Reads a domain's BIMI record (default._bimi.<domain> TXT): whether it is published, the SVG logo URL (l=) and the certificate URL (a=, a VMC or CMC for mailbox providers). Checks the v=BIMI1 tag and that the URLs are https. It does not download the logo or validate the certificate. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_csp_evaluator_audit when you need to read the Content-Security-Policy header of a site's home; security_ntp_monlist_audit when you need Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_bimi_record_audit
title: Reads a domain's BIMI record: whether it is published
